fields.name: Markers
fields.about: The transaction markers to be written.

fields.name: ProducerEpoch
fields.about: The current epoch associated with the producer ID.

fields.name: TransactionResult
fields.about: The result of the transaction to write to the partitions (false = ABORT, true = COMMIT).

fields.name: Topics
fields.about: Each topic that we want to write transaction marker(s) for.

fields.name: PartitionIndexes
fields.about: The indexes of the partitions to write transaction markers for.

fields.name: CoordinatorEpoch
fields.about: Epoch associated with the transaction state partition hosted by this transaction coordinator.
